Limitations: Same or ambiguous background and ink colors may need manual inclusion/exclusion; uncertain edge samples are retained rather than eroded
Stop durations snap to output frames within a fixed total route budget; impossible stop budgets are rejected
Rendering comparisons use mean channel error <3 and fraction of pixels exceeding 20 <3.5%, not exact cross-engine pixel identity
Existing precision masks require recomputation with the numeric preset to regenerate their faint edge protection; OBS packages must be exported again
